scope: Reusable Sobel3x3/L2/NMS stages only; no final Canny hysteresis qualification
source: C1 or C3 unsigned8 with independent byte pitch; whole source replicate boundary
gradient: Sobel integer dx=sum(pixel*i*(j==0?2:1)), dy=sum(pixel*j*(i==0?2:1)); C3 selects first channel with maximal dx*dx+dy*dy
magnitude: exact floor integer square root of dx*dx+dy*dy
direction: horizontal abs(dy)*32768 < abs(dx)*13573; vertical abs(dy)*32768 > abs(dx)*(13573+65536); otherwise diagonal sign(dx*dy)
nms: retain integer magnitude iff >= both directional neighbours; same full-image replicated boundary
threshold: Exact every element of all four outputs, independent NumPy reference; no numeric relaxation
pending: Native NPP and NPP+ hysteresis differ and remain under investigation; this contract cannot promote an original sample
